text:
I wrote here recently about my husband's experience in trying to convert his German driver license to Israeli. On the first appointment he was told to provide an affidavit, since his German license didn't have expiry date. 

Some of you suggested to schedule an appointment in another location. 
So this morning he went to Jerusalem (Agripas branch). The clerk there didn't even have a computer... She told him he needs a 5 years visa (he has B1 spouse visa) and sent him away in a very impolite way. In fact she told him she didn't have time to explain him what he needs. 

My husband likes to go to this meetings alone, but my feeling is that without shouting from my side and making a fuss things won't move. This situation is highly upsetting and pathetic. Obviously these clerks of MOT don't even know the rules. What a shame!
